description: This file defines a React functional component 'TeamMembersComponent' that renders a table of team members with their details, actions for editing and deleting members, and utility functions for formatting numbers and retrieving member-specific data.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Converts a number to a string, handling scientific notation and trailing zeros for display.

methods.name: getUserSpend
methods.description: Retrieves the spend amount in USD for a specific user from team data.

methods.name: getUserBudget
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the maximum budget for a specific user.

methods.name: getUserRateLimits
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the rate limits (RPM and TPM) for a specific user.
